def min_func(a, b):
    return a if a < b else b

def dfs(n, x):

        n = -n
    r = (n // tmp[x]) * x
    n = n - (n // tmp[x]) * tmp[x]
    if n == 0:
        return r
    return r + min_func(dfs(n, x-1), x + dfs(tmp[x] - n, x-1))

tmp[1] = 1
